text:
zane: Quick async follow-up from the INC-345 postmortem. We identified a repeating cache-eviction pattern tied to a TTL change. Need owners for runbook edits, a safe canary rollout plan, and an explicit rollback checklist. No meeting unless blockers.
sasha: I can write the playbook paragraph that covers 'recurring eviction' and the escalation flow.
maya: I will take the runbook PR and include the exact diagnostics and config diff. Plan: PR in 48 hours.
liam: I'll own the rollout and verification. Proposal: feature-flagged TTL change -> 5% canary, monitor, then ramp. ETA: canary next Thu, verification 7 days.
katie-cs: Product/support needs a short note describing the user-visible change and rollback behavior. I'll draft once we have the final wording.
ops-bot: Created tasks: INC-345-FU-501 (owner: maya), INC-345-FU-502 (owner: liam), INC-345-FU-503 (owner: sasha). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-501, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-502, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-503 :white_check_mark:
zane: Maya please include the diagnostic commands we used in the outage and a one-line revert command. Liam, add the exact observability queries and alert thresholds to the checklist.
maya: Adding diagnostics to runbook now:
```
# eviction rate over last 5m (Prometheus)
curl -s "http://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[5m])" | jq .data
# keys with shortest TTL (staging)
redis-cli -h staging.cache.internal --raw keys "session:*" | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'printf "%s\t" {} && redis-cli -h staging.cache.internal ttl {}' | sort -k2 -n | head -n 25
# recent cache-set callers (logs)
curl -s "http://logs.internal/search?query=\"cache.set\"" | head -n 50
```
liam: Rollout checklist (will add kubectl snippets): deploy TTL change behind feature flag to canary pool (5% pods), monitor 5m windows for evictions and p95 latency, and watch error rates. Abort criteria: evictions > 10/min OR p95 latency +30% vs baseline OR any sustained increase in 4xx from cache. If abort, perform rollback commands in runbook.
sasha: For playbook, add a 'repeat eviction' rule: if the same cluster logs 2 eviction incidents within 10 days, auto-open a recurring-review ticket and page oncall-sre + oncall-platform. Include example pager payload.
maya: Draft rollback commands for runbook:
```
# disable feature flag immediately
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/flags/ttl_experiment -d '{"enabled":false}'
# undo k8s rollout to last known good revision
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=previous
# cleanup any experiment keys (best-effort)
redis-cli -h cache.primary --scan --pattern "experiment:ttl:*" | xargs -r redis-cli -h cache.primary del || true
```
liam: I'll add the Grafana queries and exact alert thresholds to the checklist, plus the kube commands to shift traffic and to force a quick rollback if needed.
katie-cs: I'll prepare a short 3-line support blurb that explains the TTL change, expected user impact (none expected), and the rollback plan. Will ping PM for a quick approval.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 4 days for INC-345-FU-501.
zane: Action recap and deadlines:
- INC-345-FU-501 (maya): runbook PR with config diff + diagnostics + rollback snippet (due in 48h)
- INC-345-FU-502 (liam): canary rollout plan + observability queries + thresholds (canary next Thu)
- INC-345-FU-503 (sasha): playbook escalation paragraph + pager example (due EOD Fri)
katie-cs: Noted. I'll have the support blurb ready within 3 business days after runbook PR lands.
maya: I'll include a small test plan for QA to exercise in staging (verify no unexpected evictions at 1.5x load).
liam: If canary reports a spike, we run the rollback snippet and then open a hotfix ticket. I'll add a single-command rollback alias to make that simple.
zane: Good. If blockers appear, request a 15m sync. Otherwise we can close this thread once the canary verification completes and action tickets are resolved. Thanks all. :spiral_calendar:
